relevance_note: Systematic LAMP2 screen of 50 HCM index cases that describes two index patients with LAMP2 mutations and their families in detail: 'Two new mutations in the LAMP2 gene were identified in two index cases'.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a Python script in the scratch directory only assembled the JSON and checked every span verbatim. The paper has no tables; pedigrees (Figure 3) and sequencing traces are images only, so pedigree positions beyond II-1 and III-1 were not used. Labels: 'patient 1' and 'patient 2' are the paper's own labels (also 'index patient 1' / II-1 and 'index patient 2' / III-1). Relatives of patient 1: the paper names 'the mother of patient 1' (tested, did not carry the variant) and says 'parents and the sister' had no cardiac or muscular disease; the second parent is labelled 'parent of patient 1' because the word 'father' is not written. The normal physical examination, echocardiography and ECG of these relatives were recorded as excluded rows from the named-group statement; under D-27 they exclude no specific checklist item, so their checklists are 'not reported'. The same applies to the normal ECG and 'no symptoms' of the mother of patient 2. Relatives of patient 2: three uncles and the grandmother died of cardiac disease (no DNA); 'Cardiomyopathy was present in all four' was applied to each; skeletal myopathy (3 of 4), conduction defect, pacemaker and ophthalmic abnormalities (2 of 4) are counts without names and were not assigned. Uncles' ages at death are a range ('7 to 34 years') and were not assigned. 'ref 12 patient' is a previously published case given one individual-level feature (ophthalmic abnormality) in the Discussion; no variant row because no variant is printed for that person in the text. Patient 1 sex is not stated in the text (only implied by the Discussion's 'male patients ... This was the case in our two patients'), so recorded 'not reported'. Patient 1 inheritance: the paper calls the variant de novo after testing only the mother ('DNA was available for the mothers'); rule 8 / D-24 requires both parents tested, so inheritance is 'not reported' with the statement quoted. Variant strings: the abstract prints '657C.T' (the '>' is lost in conversion; the Results give 'C/T657 transition'); the deletion is printed '173\_179del' with a Markdown escape, kept verbatim. The GenBank accession S79873 is stated in the sentence describing both mutations, next to the first; it was recorded as the transcript for both. No c./p. prefixes are printed; Q174X recorded as the protein description for patient 1, the deletion's protein effect is only 'premature stop codon (codon 17)'. Muscle biopsy findings ('Abnormalities were similar for both') and the 'clinical skeletal myopathy' and 'second degree atrioventricular block in both of these patients' statements were applied to both index patients as named-group statements. Age at diagnosis for both index patients is the age at clinical HCM diagnosis. Temporal changes (normal ejection fraction and LV diameter at first, reduced later; no skeletal muscle abnormality in patient 2 at first, mild distal weakness later) were recorded as separate rows, not as contradictions; checklist items reflect the later observed status. Cohort size recorded as the 50 index cases screened for LAMP2 (197 index cases were considered initially). The Markdown also contains an unrelated 'Images in cardiology' item (calcified mediastinal haematoma) after the references; ignored.
